performanceEstimate.method: Whole-map instance triangle / material-primitive count from actual GLBs, including disabled ceilings; no batching/culling assumption.
performanceEstimate.scope: candidate full map, separate from hero scene

reviewBudget.behaviour: review required above threshold; never claim real-device performance

limitations: Worst-case full-map display estimate, not a measured FPS or GPU time.
Material primitives are counted per visible instance; renderer culling, transparency and draw grouping can change actual costs.
Trees are individually authored GLB instances; no LOD or game integration is introduced.

authoredForestDensity.scalePolicy: New cedars retain authored natural scales. Conflicting instances are omitted, never shrunk to fit.

limitations: Water, fixed 7 objects and FOE deliberately omitted from rendering.
This proves standalone layout loading and profile selection; no collision, gameplay regression or FPS approval.
Existing ceiling GLB SHA is pinned by each candidate row and checked against browser/local bytes; it remains outside the new 17-asset manifest.
